title: 第517章 本座都替你感到丢人第516章 老祖现身
content_zh:
第517章本座都替你感到丢人
齐王姜尚的心中掀起了惊涛骇浪。
他当了数十年的藩王，见过无数强者，也与大乾皇室的多位供奉打过交道，自认为对天下强者的实力分布了然于心。
可今日，凌清雪的出现，彻底打破了他的认知。
“剑尊，绝对是剑尊！”
齐王在心中反复确认着这个判断，每确认一次，他的脸色就苍白一分。
剑尊是什么概念？
那是超越了剑皇的存在，是渡过了剑心劫，迈入先天生灵之境的强者！
别说在大乾王朝，在历代前朝历史中，剑尊的数量也屈指可数，
每一位剑尊，都是足以镇压一方的存在，是连皇室都要以礼相待的顶级大能！
而在齐王身后，原本嚣张跋扈的姜云天，此刻已经彻底慌了。
他瘫坐在地上，半边脸肿得像猪头一样，可此刻他却完全顾不上疼痛，因为他的心中充满了恐惧。
“这女人好强，巅峰剑皇也不过如此，怕是传说中的剑尊！”
姜云天喃喃自语，连声音都在颤抖：
“怎么可能，青云剑宗这种破地方，怎么会有剑尊坐镇？”
他原本以为，父王带着数十位通天境强者、数位剑皇大能亲临，碾死周尘就像碾死一只蚂蚁一样简单。
他甚至已经想好了，等抓住周尘之后，要怎么折磨他，才能解自己的心头之恨。
可没想到，半路居然杀出一个剑尊！
那可是剑尊啊！
在整个武道体系中，剑尊对应的可是武者的涅槃境！

那是真正超凡脱俗的存在，是脱离了凡人范畴的先天生灵！
别说他一个小小的齐王世子，就算是整个齐王府，在剑尊面前也不过是大一点的蝼蚁罢了！
“完了……全完了……”
姜云天脸色惨白，浑身哆嗦，连站都站不起来。
他此刻只想找个地缝钻进去，离这里越远越好。
他甚至开始后悔，为什么要招惹周尘那个煞星？
如果不是他非要找周尘的麻烦，就不会引来今天这场祸事！
如果不引来今天这场祸事，就不会惊动青云剑宗的老祖！
如果不惊动青云剑宗的老祖，他现在还好端端地在齐王府享福呢！
可现在，说什么都晚了。
而此刻，齐王姜尚虽然心中也是惊涛骇浪，但毕竟当了数十年的藩王，城府与定力远非姜云天可比。
他知道，越是这种时候，越不能慌乱。
一旦乱了方寸，就真的没有任何回旋余地了。
“剑尊，此等存在，在整个王都都没有几位，怕是只有那位深不可测的女帝陛下，才能与之媲美了……”
齐王在心中暗暗想道，脸上的表情却尽量保持平静。
他整理了一下衣襟，对着凌清雪拱手行礼：
content_en:
Chapter 517 I feel ashamed for you
Qi Wang Jiang Shang's heart was filled with turmoil.
He has been a vassal king for decades, has met countless powerful people, and has dealt with many ministers of the Daqian royal family. He thinks that he has a clear understanding of the strength distribution of the powerful people in the world.
But today, Ling Qingxue's appearance completely broke his cognition.
"Sword Master, definitely Sword Master!"
King Qi repeatedly confirmed this judgment in his heart. Every time he confirmed it, his face became paler.
What is the concept of Sword Master?
That is an existence that has surpassed the Sword Emperor, a strong man who has survived the Sword Heart Tribulation and entered the realm of innate beings!
Not to mention the Daqian Dynasty, in the history of previous dynasties, the number of sword masters was also very few.
Every sword master is capable of suppressing one party and is a top power that even the royal family must treat with courtesy!
Behind King Qi, Jiang Yuntian, who was originally arrogant and domineering, was completely panicked at this moment.
He collapsed on the ground, half of his face swollen like a pig's head, but at this moment he couldn't care less about the pain because his heart was full of fear.
"This woman is so strong. The peak sword emperor is no more than that. I'm afraid she is the legendary sword master!"
Jiang Yuntian murmured to himself, even his voice was trembling:
"How is it possible? How can a place like the Qingyun Sword Sect be in such a bad state, with a Sword Master sitting in charge?"
He originally thought that his father would come in person with dozens of Tongtian Realm experts and several Sword Emperors, and crushing Zhou Chen to death would be as easy as crushing an ant.
He had even thought about how to torture Zhou Chen after catching him in order to relieve his hatred.
Unexpectedly, a sword master actually appeared on the way!
That's the Sword Master!
In the entire martial arts system, the Sword Master corresponds to the nirvana state of the warrior!
That is a truly otherworldly existence, an innate being that has escaped the realm of mortals!
Not to mention he is a little Prince Qi, even the entire Prince Qi's Mansion is just a bigger ant in front of the Sword Lord!
"It's over...it's all over..."
Jiang Yuntian's face was pale, his whole body was trembling, and he couldn't even stand up.
At this moment, he just wants to find a crack in the ground and crawl into it, as far away from here as possible.
He even began to regret, why did he provoke the evil star Zhou Chen?
If he hadn't insisted on causing trouble for Zhou Chen, he wouldn't have caused today's disaster!
If it hadn't caused today's disaster, the ancestors of the Qingyun Sword Sect would not have been alarmed!
If the ancestor of the Qingyun Sword Sect had not been alarmed, he would still be enjoying the blessings in Prince Qi's Mansion now!
But now, it's too late to say anything.
At this moment, although King Jiang Shang of Qi was also in a state of turmoil, after all, he had been a vassal king for decades, and his palace and determination were far beyond that of Jiang Yuntian.
He knew that at times like this, he couldn't panic.
Once things get messed up, there really is no room for maneuver.
"Sword Master, there are only a few such beings in the entire royal capital. I am afraid that only the unfathomable Empress, Her Majesty, can rival him..."
King Qi thought secretly in his heart, but tried to keep the expression on his face as calm as possible.
He straightened his clothes and saluted Ling Qingxue:
